info.name: postgres-practice — Marketplace API
info.description:
Multi-vendor marketplace backend (NestJS + PostgreSQL + MongoDB + RabbitMQ).

The collection is self-wiring: auth requests store the token pair, create-requests capture entity ids (storeId, productId, variantId, cartId, orderId, …) into variables. Select the `postgres-practice — Local` environment and run the folders top to bottom for the full happy path:

1. Auth → Sign Up
2. Addresses → Create Address
3. Wallet → Deposit
4. Stores → Create Store → Activate Store
5. Categories → Create Category
6. Products → Create Product → Update Product (set ACTIVE)
7. Stocks → Adjust Stock (INCOME)
8. Carts → Add Item
9. Orders → Checkout
10. Payments → Pay Order
11. Orders → Update Order Status (seller): ACCEPTED → PROCESSING → IN_DELIVERY → DELIVERED
12. Orders → Complete My Order
13. Reviews → Create Review

All protected endpoints inherit Bearer auth with {{accessToken}} from the collection.

request.description: Registers an account together with a profile and a wallet. Returns { accessToken, refreshToken }; both are stored into variables automatically.
Signs in with email or username (send either "email" or "username" plus "password"). Tokens are stored automatically.
Rotates the refresh session (the old refresh token is revoked) and returns a fresh token pair.
Current account with its profile.
Revokes the refresh session. Returns 204.
All fields are optional: name, lastname, username, phone, avatar.
type: HOME | WORK | OTHER. Setting isDefault=true clears the flag on other addresses. Saves addressId.
Wallet ledger, newest first. Every entry carries balanceBefore/balanceAfter.
amount is a decimal string with up to 2 fraction digits.
Fails with 422 INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS when the balance is too low.
Creates a store in DRAFT status; the slug is generated from the name. Saves storeId and storeSlug.
Public store page. Only ACTIVE/SUSPENDED stores are visible.
Allowed transitions: DRAFT→ACTIVE/CLOSED, ACTIVE→SUSPENDED/CLOSED, SUSPENDED→ACTIVE/CLOSED.
Soft delete: the store is marked CLOSED and hidden.
Pass parentId to create a child category. Saves categoryId and categorySlug.
Only ACTIVE products of ACTIVE stores. Enable query params to filter.
Product details with variants, categories and review rating.
Owner view: all statuses including DRAFT and ARCHIVED.
Creates a DRAFT product with variants in your store (at least one variant, exactly one default). Saves productId and variantId.
Also accepts name, description, brand, images, attributes, categoryIds. status: DRAFT | ACTIVE | ARCHIVED.
Soft delete: archives the product.
Saves the new variantId (overwrites the previous one).
Soft delete: the variant becomes INACTIVE.
INCOME adds quantity, WRITE_OFF removes it, CORRECTION sets the absolute value. Creates the stock record on first use and journals a movement. Saves stockId.
Stock levels for every variant of the store, with available = quantity - reserved.
Movement journal (INCOME/RESERVE/RELEASE/SALE/RETURN/CORRECTION/WRITE_OFF) with before/after quantities.
One cart per store, with line totals and subtotal.
Adds a variant to the cart of its store (creates the cart if needed) after an availability check. Saves cartId and cartItemId.
Removing the last item deletes the cart as well.
Creates a PENDING order: snapshots products/prices/address, reserves stock and deletes the cart — all in one transaction. Saves orderId and orderItemId.
Full order: items, payments, status history, address snapshot and timestamps.
Buyer cancellation, allowed only while the order is PENDING. Releases stock reservations and refunds wallet payments.
Buyer confirms receipt: DELIVERED → COMPLETED.

Allowed chain: PENDING→ACCEPTED→PROCESSING→IN_DELIVERY→DELIVERED; CANCELLED until shipped; RETURNED after DELIVERED/COMPLETED. Pass trackingNumber/deliveryProvider with IN_DELIVERY. DELIVERED commits stock sales, CANCELLED/RETURNED refund payments.
Debits the buyer's wallet for order.totalAmount and writes a PAYMENT ledger entry atomically. Retrying with the same idempotencyKey returns the existing payment. Saves paymentId.
Allowed only for items of your own DELIVERED/COMPLETED orders; one review per product. Saves reviewId.
